defect: generated-clock period is twice the RTL divider period
rationale: divider_q toggles on every ref_clk edge, so divided_clk has one rising edge every two reference cycles. The generated clock declares divide_by 4 and therefore grants an incorrect period to slow_state timing.

mutation.description: Declared divided_clk with divide_by 4 although the retained toggle divider produces ref_clk divided by 2.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Retained the clock-divider toggle and a downstream generated-clock register; removed runtime reconfiguration, clock gating, and technology-cell details.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: divided_clk is a toggling flop output (divide by 2) but is constrained divide_by 4.
